zh.metadataDescription: 查看发布版本、准备输入并在 ANS 运行工作流。
zh.author: 由 {name} 维护 · 已通过管理员复核
zh.resumeOutputBody: 将真实经历整理成个人页面。完成后可预览并下载 HTML 文件，网站上线需另行部署。
zh.genericOutputBody: 运行结果取自当前版本的最后一个执行步骤。完成后可查看结果和逐步执行记录。
zh.resumeFactsBody: 姓名、个人定位和自我介绍为必填。教育、技能及联系方式按需要填写。
zh.resumeProjectsBody: 每个项目需要名称与具体描述。说明自己负责的工作，可补充角色和成果链接。
zh.resumePreferencesBody: 选择版式、强调色及中文或英文输出，这些选择会进入本次成果。
zh.noVariables: 当前版本未声明需要填写的输入变量。运行前仍可在下方确认模型与费用。
zh.resumeChoices: 运行前确认资料、风格、语言与费用；完成后核对文字及事实，再用于投递或发布。
zh.genericChoices: 运行前确认输入、模型与费用；完成后核对结果。流程中的条件判断由程序执行。
zh.processExplanation: 下面按实际执行顺序排列，各步骤标明接收的上游结果。编号不代表相邻步骤一定相连。
zh.receivesInput: 无上游依赖，可使用本次输入
zh.nodeLimits: 超时 {seconds} 秒 · 最多重试 {retries} 次

nodeDescriptions.prompt: 将输入与上游结果填入已发布的提示内容。
nodeDescriptions.template: 按照固定模板整理输入与已有结果。
nodeDescriptions.model: 调用模型处理这个步骤的内容，调用会按当前规则计费。
nodeDescriptions.condition: 按已发布条件比较上游结果，产生判断值。
nodeDescriptions.output: 整理上游结果作为输出；具体交付格式由当前版本决定。

zh.loginTitle: 登录后，开始自己的运行
zh.loginBody: 输入和成果保存在你的运行记录中。登录后返回此页，填写资料并确认费用再开始。
zh.executionLimit: 单次执行最长 120 秒，每个步骤另有超时和重试上限。
zh.versionNotice: 普通工作流在点击运行时读取最新发布版本，任务创建后版本固定。配方与市场工作流会核对已确认版本；页面停留较久时请刷新核对。
zh.privacyNotice: 输入会随运行记录保存，请避免填写身份证号、住址等敏感信息。
zh.reviewNotice: AI 生成内容需要你核对，尤其是个人经历、数据和引用。
zh.unavailableTitle: 这个发布版本暂时无法运行
zh.unavailableBody: 当前定义未能通过读取或结构校验。运行入口已暂停，请联系维护者修复后再试。
zh.rawDefinition: 查看输入变量与原始发布定义

en.metadataDescription: Review the published version, prepare inputs and run this workflow on ANS.
en.author: Maintained by {name} · Reviewed by an administrator
en.resumeOutputBody: Turn your real experience into a personal page. Preview and download an HTML file after completion. Publishing the website requires separate hosting.
en.genericOutputBody: The result comes from the final executed step in this version. Review the result and the execution record after completion.
en.resumeFactsBody: Name, headline and introduction are required. Add education, skills and contact details as needed.
en.resumeProjectsBody: Each project needs a name and description. Explain your contribution and optionally add your role and a result link.
en.resumePreferencesBody: Choose a layout, accent color and Chinese or English output. These choices become part of your result.
en.noVariables: This version declares no input fields. Confirm the model and cost in the run area below before starting.
en.resumeChoices: Confirm your facts, style, language and cost before running. Check the generated copy and facts before applying or publishing.
en.genericChoices: Confirm inputs, model and cost before running, then review the result. Condition steps are evaluated automatically.
en.processExplanation: Steps follow the actual execution order and show their upstream inputs. Consecutive numbers do not necessarily mean connected steps.
en.receivesInput: No upstream dependency; can use this run's inputs

nodeDescriptions.prompt: Fill the published prompt with inputs and upstream results.
nodeDescriptions.template: Apply a fixed template to inputs and existing results.
nodeDescriptions.model: Process this step with a model. Calls are charged under the current billing rules.
nodeDescriptions.condition: Compare upstream results using the published condition and produce a decision value.
nodeDescriptions.output: Prepare upstream results for output. The published version determines the delivery format.

en.loginTitle: Sign in to start your own run
en.loginBody: Inputs and results are saved to your run history. Return here after signing in, fill in your details and confirm the cost to start.
en.executionLimit: A run can execute for up to 120 seconds. Each step has its own timeout and retry limits.
en.versionNotice: Generic workflows use the latest published version when you click run, then keep that version for the task. Recipes and marketplace workflows verify the confirmed version. Refresh if this page has been open for a while.
en.privacyNotice: Inputs are saved with the run record. Avoid sensitive information such as identity numbers or home addresses.
en.reviewNotice: Review AI output, especially personal experience, data and references.
en.unavailableTitle: This published version cannot run right now
en.unavailableBody: The current definition could not be read or failed structural validation. Running is paused until the maintainer fixes it.
en.rawDefinition: View input variables and the raw published definition
